name: release-checklist
description: Walks an agent through the checks a release candidate has to clear.

# Release checklist

Use this Skill when a release candidate has been cut and has not been signed off.

1. Read the candidate's version and its changelog entry.
2. Confirm every item in the changelog names the change it belongs to.
3. Confirm the test report for the candidate is present and complete.
4. Record the outcome on the release record.

## Sign-off

Hand the candidate to a release manager when any check above has no result, and
say which one.
